node.statement: Support classification by confinement. By the confinement hypothesis, every support fiber j of an admissible row is either one of the five actors, or a nonactor fiber with p_j ∈ conv{p_v,p_w,p_f,p_z,p_o}, or a nonactor fiber in the slab 0 ≤ y_j ≤ 1. In the actor and hull cases the x-coordinate lies in the actor-hull x-range [-A, 1] read off from the coordinates of 1.1 (v,o at x=0, w at x=-a·A, f at x=-A, z at x=1); in every case the transverse displacement is subject to the ℓ¹ cost of the previous step.
